dcat_keyword_sm: information architecture; web navigation; academic libraries
dct_description_sm: The written research associated with this dataset is currently under submission for publication. This file will be updated once the publication is accepted.

This dataset contains data on the information architecture on the library websites of Canadian doctoral-granting institutions. Navigation category labels and contents were exhaustively collected for 37 institutions meeting the sample criteria. Two levels of coding are applied: category codes and item (page-level) codes. The dataset also includes frequency analysis and basic statistics for various aspects of the data (see README for details).
dct_title_s: Canadian academic library websites: categories and contents
